Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. As specified, we can't meet this request. Our largest room is the Loft, which holds at most 24 people, so it can't take 50. The Studio is smaller still, with a maximum of 12 people.

I can't confirm a booking in this message. Nothing is held. The listed prices are fixed, so we can't offer a special total price. We don't offer either of those things. Dates would also need a separate availability check.

There is one option you could consider. You would have to agree to it, and it means giving something up:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft | 24 | €420 | headcount reduced from 50 to at most 24; budget raised from €100 to €420 (+€320) |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option is the Loft for up to 24 people, for a 4-hour booking. You would give up the group size of 50 and reduce it to 24 at most. The cost would also be higher than your budget, as the table shows. The Loft is wheelchair accessible and Wi-Fi is included. We have assumed the standard 4-hour block and no extra services, such as catering, a projector or a facilitator.

If you'd like to look at this option, or tell us more about what you need, please get in touch.

Kind regards
